requirements.title: Orchestration of LLM agents via workflow with context transfer through MCP
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Launch within 5 seconds; atomicity enforced; traceId logged.
requirements.description: Workflow consists of 5 agents; on agent failure retry/escalate; step-by-step traceId; launch ≤5 sec.

requirements.title: Second requirement
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Система должна хранить требования в базе данных и обеспечивать возможность их поиска и получения.
requirements.description: Система должна обеспечивать возможность сохранения требований. Система должна предоставлять интерфейс для их чтения/записи.

requirements.title: Third requirement
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Система должна обеспечивать безопасность и целостность данных требований.
requirements.description: Требуется обеспечение безопасности данных требований. Требуется целостность данных требований.

requirements.title: Fourth requirement
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Система должна генерировать отчеты на основе требований и обеспечивать их доступность.

requirements.title: Automatic Ingestion of User Requirements
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Upon receiving user input containing requirement statements, the system extracts and persists each statement.
requirements.description: The system must detect and ingest user-requested requirements from natural language input and store them.

requirements.title: LLM-driven Candidate Generation
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Generated candidates satisfy user intent and are displayed in readable format.
requirements.description: Generate candidate requirements using LLM agents and present suggestions to the user.

requirements.title: Persistent Storage in MCP Server
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Requirements survive server restarts and modifications are tracked.
requirements.description: Store requirements persistently in the MCP server database with version control.

requirements.title: CRUD Operations on Requirements
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Each operation succeeds or fails appropriately with proper error handling.
requirements.description: Support create, read, update, and delete operations on requirement records.

requirements.title: Natural Language Translation Layer
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Translation accuracy meets user-defined benchmarks and latency ≤ 200 ms.
requirements.description: Translate natural language user input into machine-readable requirement formats and vice versa.

requirements.title: High Availability & Failover
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: System remains accessible during planned maintenance and recovers within SLA.
requirements.description: Ensure 99.9% uptime with automatic failover mechanisms for server failures.

requirements.title: Low Latency Processing
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Latency measured under peak load stays below threshold.
requirements.description: Ingestion and retrieval latency ≤ 200 ms for all requirement operations.

requirements.title: Encryption & Secure Transmission
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: All stored and transmitted data is unreadable without keys/certificates.
requirements.description: Encrypt data at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3).

requirements.title: Auditability & Traceability
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Audit logs are immutable and retrievable for compliance.
requirements.description: Log every change to requirements with timestamps and user identifiers.

requirements.title: Scalability & Concurrency
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: System maintains response time under load and scales resources automatically.
requirements.description: Handle up to 10,000 concurrent sessions and scale horizontally.

requirements.title: Ingestion sources: PDF, DOCX, MD, JSON, CSV, transcripts, tickets
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Load ≥6 formats; extraction works; source preserved; parse errors logged.
requirements.description: Load ≥6 formats; extract text; save source; log parsing errors.

expertRules.name: Проверка атомарности требований
expertRules.description: Требование должно быть атомарным (описывать одну функциональность)
expertRules.example: Система должна позволять создавать и редактировать требования

expertRules.name: Проверка неоднозначных терминов
expertRules.description: Проверка на наличие субъективных и неизмеримых терминов
expertRules.example: Система должна работать быстро и удобно

expertRules.name: Обязательность критериев приемки
expertRules.description: Требование должно содержать детализированные критерии приемки
